.flow-text { fill: #ffb347; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-anchor: middle; paint-order: stroke; stroke: #282a30; stroke-width: 4px; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.legend { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 12px 0 0; color: #b7beca; font-size: 12px; }
.legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #24262b; margin: 0; padding: 18px; color: #f3f4f6; }
.top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.card { background: #303238; border: 1px solid #4a4d55; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); }
.label { color: #b7beca; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
h2 { font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 10px; color: #ffb347; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 90px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.track { height: 10px; background: #25272c; border: 1px solid #4a4d55; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.donut-area { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 170px 1fr; gap: 16px; align-items: center; }
.donut { width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08); }
.donut::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: #303238; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #4a4d55; }
.donut-center { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 2; font-weight: 900; font-size: 24px; color: #ffb347; }
.legend-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 7px 0; font-size: 12px; color: #b7beca; }
.histogram { height: 190px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a4d55; padding: 8px 4px 0; }
.day-col { flex: 1; min-width: 28px; text-align: center; position: relative; }
.funnel-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 95px 1fr 42px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.funnel-track { height: 20px; background: #25272c; border: 1px solid #4a4d55; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #303238; border: 1px solid #4a4d55; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
th, td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3d4048; text-align: left; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: top; }
th { background: #282a30; color: #b7beca; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid transparent; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .cards, .grid, .visual-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .top { flex-direction: column; } .donut-area { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; } }
